The '''Kedarin Highlands''' were a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG" /> It was used as a racetrack for the [[Lok Marathon]].<ref name="SWG:LM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kedarin Highlands are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
